structure_note: The document is NOT a single flat list of ticket tiers. It contains four distinct ticketing categories: (1) Single-Day Admission - Individual, (2) Single-Day Admission - Group, (3) Citizen of the Kingdom Membership (a recurring monthly subscription, not a day pass), and (4) Birthday Packages (flat-fee event bookings). A fifth section, 'Exclusive Member Events', lists non-priced perks attached to the Hero Membership tier rather than a ticket tier itself.

Table cell text in the source occasionally had inconsistent line-break placement (e.g. price appearing on its own sub-line within a merged-looking cell); prices and inclusion lists were reconciled to the tier they visually belong to based on row position.
